benchmark_run_time: benchmark the average inference runtime of a fairseq model across a dataset using timeit
count_flops: count the average floating point operations per sample using the PYPAPI hardware performance counter library
max_memory: measure the average peak memory consumption in MiB across a dataset using memory_profiler
gather_all_metrics: gather run time, memory, and flop metrics for a fairseq model in a single call
S2UT: run a speech-to-units-to-waveform pipeline that chains a speech-to-unit model with a vocoder
